Review the approved [requirements.md](../../docs/requirements.md) and [architecture.md](../../docs/architecture.md). Record prioritized risks, gaps, assumptions, security and failure-mode concerns, and required decisions in [design-review.md](../../docs/design-review.md).

Do not implement or silently redesign. Stop for human disposition and approval before planning.
